name: - BEVO
fix_description: In deliver(), add a maximum limit on tAmount (e.g. require tAmount <= _tTotal * 1 / 100) to prevent single-transaction manipulation of _rTotal. Without this limit, an attacker can use a flash loan to acquire a large token position, call deliver to drastically reduce the rate, and arbitrage the inflated pair balance.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a multi-step reflective-token exploit involving a flash loan, a fee-on-transfer swap, repeated use of the token’s deliver mechanics, pair skim abuse, and final reserve extraction/repayment. It is not deeply complex, but it does require understanding protocol-specific reflective token accounting and AMM pair behavior beyond a trivial bug pattern.
